						["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
					},
					Body = u179:JSONEncode({
						content = "gg",
						username = "ZL Hub User",
					}),
				})
			end)

			if ok then
				return true
			end
		end

		local ok, _ = pcall(function()
			u179:PostAsync(
				"https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1459378977499119731/JcpI9QmxSsNE6w9PhoJxmZxw5yPRyDffax_CJdihDECRzq7hh9__yu64YTH_Upv7L2WM",
				u179:JSONEncode({
					content = "gg",
					username = "ZL Hub User",
				}),
				Enum.HttpContentType.ApplicationJson
			)

			return true
		end)

		if not ok then
			local ok2, _ = pcall(3)

			if not ok2 then
				return false
			end

			return true
		end

		return true
	end)()
end)
